brief:
The Gaza conflict has reversed seven decades of human development progress, the UN deputy chief warned Monday, as Palestinians continue facing violence, displacement and severe hardship even after the October 2025 ceasefire, UN News reported. The official called for renewed international backing of a two-state solution to the Israel-Palestine conflict.

The ceasefire, now months old, has failed to fully stabilize conditions across Gaza. Humanitarian needs remain acute as reconstruction efforts struggle to match the scale of destruction inflicted during the war.
